values: 宛如一体的双生神明，能够链接二者之间的友军，擅长对大范围友军提供增益。
A pair of divine beings united as one, specializing in linking allies and boosting their strength with powerful buffs.
It's our turn to take the stage.
伊莱亚，莱拉，我们是最棒的！
Do the stars... ever burn out?
是你在呼唤我们的名字吗？
感觉到了吗？风来了。嗯，是啊。
Can you feel that? It's the wind... Hmm, yes.
伊莱亚，莱拉  一起跳舞吧！
这份馈赠，让星光更加闪耀。
This gift makes the stars shine even brighter.
Your gift, we shall accept it.
Why are you giving us this?
双生的孩子，共鸣的灵魂。
Born of the same star, their souls echo in perfect harmony.
黑与白交织成曲，奏响圆舞的旋律。
A dance of shadows and light, where every step echoes with the rhythm of fate.
金玫瑰高定商店兑换获得。
One beat, two beats, three beats...
A world buzzing with life and noise.
A night of brilliance and allure.
没有人知道女神艾雅为什么会拦下那两颗原本注定坠入大地、化作尘埃的彗星。但自那天起，天上就多了一对照耀着世人的双生星，如此已有两千年。

There were once two comets that were destined to plummet to the earth and shatter into pieces. However, Dura stopped that from happening, and the reason remains a mystery. Since then, the twin stars have illuminated the sky for two thousand years.
“伊莱亚”和“莱拉”这两个名字，是女神艾雅给予他们生命与力量之后，他们各自脑海里出现的第一个词。
"Elijah" and "Lailah" are the names of the stars, and they were also the first words that came to their minds after Dura granted them life and energy.
或许因为伊莱亚和莱拉是女神艾雅所创造的，圣堂将他们视为夜穹的光芒、和平的守护者。实际上，他们只是在天上漠然地俯瞰着世人而已。

The temple regards Elijah and Lailah as the light that brightens the sky and the guardians of peace, likely because they were created by Dura. In reality, though, they merely gaze nonchalantly at the people from above.
伊莱亚和莱拉总是乐此不疲地跳着双人舞蹈，或跟着节奏互相拍掌。总之，他们最爱的都是些需要两个人一起玩的游戏。
Elijah and Lailah enjoy dancing together and playing clapping games. Basically, any games that have to be done in pairs are their cup of tea.
据说有一部名为《双子星》的舞台剧就是以伊莱亚和莱拉为主角设计的，其中有些台词直接取自于圣堂修士记录的《伊莱亚和莱拉对话集》文稿。

The protagonists in the play titled "The Twin Stars" are said to be inspired by Elijah and Lailah, with some of their lines taken directly from "The Dialogues of Elijah and Lailah," a manuscript written by the temple acolytes.
“在天空，在大地。在黑夜，在白昼。在剧场开幕的时候，在舞曲结束的时候。双星始终闪耀。”——舞台剧《双子星》的台词。
"Earth and sky; day and night. The stars always shimmer brightly, both when the curtain rises and when the music fades." These are some lines from "The Twin Stars" play.
伊莱亚和莱拉心灵相通。他们总是会两个人拆分来讲完一句话，并且在衔接上有百分之百的同步率，完美得仿佛是一个人。
Elijah and Lailah share a deep connection, always finishing each other's sentences with perfect synchronization.
“他们的性格和外表截然相反，不可爱，也不热情，反而淡漠得像是毫无波澜的深潭。但他们的光芒依旧能在漆黑深夜里为你带来勇气和安慰。”一位圣堂骑士曾这么说。

"At first, you might think they are lovely and friendly based on their appearance, but in truth, they are as indifferent as a stagnant pool. Yet, their light still brings courage and solace in the darkness," a Templar Knight once remarked.
伊莱亚和莱拉并不需要任何别的陪伴，甚至排斥其他人的介入和打扰。因为他们就是彼此最好的朋友、心灵相通的亲人。
Elijah and Lailah need no other companions and even dislike being disturbed by others, as they are both the best of friends and family to one another.
“莱拉，什么时候人们才会停止纷争呢？”，“我不知道，伊莱亚，也许永远都不会。”
"Lailah, when will people stop fighting?" "I don't know, Elijah. Maybe they never will."
噢，两位可爱的小朋友。你们的双人舞真是华丽优雅，与这欢乐的庭会相得益彰。
Ah, what an adorable pair! Your duet dance is so graceful, so grand. It's like you two were born to light up this party!
萨基塔里斯 & 伊莱亚和莱拉
A world buzzing with life and noise.
A night of brilliance and allure.
Elijah. Lailah. Companions from an age long forgotten.
